subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Just like businesses have corporate logos, many schools have official mascots.
• Over seventy US colleges have updated their mascots since 2010.
• The University of North Dakota changed its mascot after its previous one was deemed culturally insensitive.
• North Dakota's new mascot better reflects the university's values and student body diversity.
• Students report feeling more connected to their school identity with the new mascot.
prompt: The student wants to make and support a generalization about the effect of updating a school mascot. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Over seventy US colleges have updated their mascots, including North Dakota, whose previous mascot had been deemed culturally insensitive.
choices.B: North Dakota is just one of over seventy US colleges that have updated their mascots.
choices.C: Updating a problematic school mascot can strengthen student connection to their institution, as was the case when North Dakota changed its mascot to better reflect university values and student diversity.
choices.D: After its previous mascot was deemed culturally insensitive, the University of North Dakota changed its mascot to better reflect the university's values and student diversity.

explanation:
Choice C is correct. It generalizes that updating mascots can strengthen student connection, citing University of North Dakota's mascot change as an example.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the sentence emphasizes why the mascot of North Dakota was changed; it doesn't make and support a generalization about the effect of updating a school mascot.
